context:
Goal: nothing falls out across a compaction, in any role.
Problem (goal): the audit each session runs after compaction compares the transcript with the handoff; it never checks that work said to have landed is on main.
Based on (read): hooks/precompact_handoff_prompt.md on main (the Explore Sonnet audit, marker "Audit:"); step coordinator-transcript-reconcile adds a main and PR check for the coordinator only.
Departs from: main, where the audit reads transcript and handoff only — adds a check of each landed or done claim against main, the open PRs and the record branch, for every role.

options.gain: A claim that work landed when it did not is caught at the next compaction, in every role.
options.how: The audit after each compaction also checks each "landed", "merged" or "done" claim in the handoff against main, the open PRs and the record branch, for every standing session.
options.label: Yes, check every claim against main (Recommended)
options.lose: Each audit reads git and GitHub too: a few more reads per compaction.

options.how: The audit checks the transcript against the handoff only; only the coordinator also checks main and the PRs.
options.label: Keep the audit as it is
options.lose: A false "landed" claim in a runner's or triage's handoff goes unchecked.

shown.label: Yes, check every claim against main (Recommended)
Keep the audit as it is

title: Should the audit after each compaction also check every "landed" claim against main?
why: You asked whether every session still sends a Sonnet agent to check its transcript against what landed. Today it checks the transcript against the handoff, not against main.
